title: Telemetry event
description: One usage event, one line of <venture>/.naive/telemetry.jsonl; the one schema the plugin beta and Mentura share. Opt-in only (telemetry.enabled in naive.config.json). An event carries no record contents and no _private path: only which capability ran, when, for how long and how it ended. It leaves the machine only when telemetry.send is true and a person set it (packages/naive/src/engine/telemetry.mjs).

capability.description: A capability id from beta/capabilities.json, or core

venture.description: A salted hash of the venture id, never the id; the salt stays in the venture's .naive/telemetry-salt and is never sent
